messages.subject: Mining & Environmental Executive | ESG, Regulatory & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Samantha,

Your retained-search work across environmental, geoscience, mining, infrastructure and energy leadership is relevant to my background in responsible mining and regulatory engagement. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where environmental and social performance, permitting and institutional trust are central to execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
